description: Main entry point for a Flutter application defining the app structure, routing, and main UI. It includes the MyApp widget which sets up the MaterialApp with a route to a login screen, and the MyHomePage widget which renders a scaffold with a button to navigate.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with title, theme, routes, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home screen with a scaffold containing app bar, message, and a floating button.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class managing the build method for MyHomePage, rendering the UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for MyApp and _MyHomePageState.
